posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
Okay I just upgraded Battlefield 1942's game and server from v1.0 (the demo) to v1.61 (the latest version) on https://t.co/6C8H8KtSaU

That involved another round of decompiling it and lots of new bug fixes to make it work in the web on multiplayer

But it works now and the game is much better now, v1.61 came out in 2004, two years after the original v1.0

The gameplay is crazy and intense and this is essentially the godfather of every modern Battlefield and Call of Duty game

Max players now is 64, come play! I recommend Chrome on your laptop!
posts.text_zh:
好了，我刚把 https://bf1942.pieter.com 上的《战地 1942》游戏和服务器从 v1.0（试玩版）升级到了 v1.61（最新版）

这又经历了一轮反编译，修了很多新 bug，才让它能在网页端多人联机运行

不过现在能跑了，游戏也好玩多了。v1.61 发布于 2004 年，比最初的 v1.0 晚了两年

玩法疯狂又紧张，它基本上就是所有现代《战地》和《使命召唤》游戏的鼻祖

现在最多支持 64 名玩家，快来玩！推荐在笔记本上用 Chrome！

One of the most important questions of our time:

"If AI can build almost anything, what should I build?"

It's the question behind most of the anxiety I hear about AI right now

I broke down the 8 kinds of businesses I think get stronger as AI gets better https://t.co/cqr718RHur

“如果 AI 几乎什么都能做出来，那我该做什么？”

我拆解了 8 类我认为会随着 AI 变强而变得更强的生意
